statements.t: Other factors not currently anticipated may also materially and adversely affect our results of operations, cash flows, and financial position.

The Company appealed, and following a series of technical and commercial reviews, the DOE reinstated the award in its entirety in January 2026, with no change to funds awarded or to technical and commercial milestones, and with an updated contracted project schedule to reflect the time spent in the review process.
The temporary termination and reinstatement did not result in a material change to the Company’s project timeline or capital program.

Following receipt of the approval to export $100 million of our black mass product, the Company expects revenue to begin recovering in the second quarter as it resumes or expands activities previously constrained by the restrictions.

The Company will continue to rely on sales of our common shares, debt, or other financings to fund its business operations as needed beyond any cash generated from internal operations and the government tax credits and grants we have been awarded.

There is no assurance that we will achieve any additional sales of our securities or arrange for debt or other financings to fund planned operating activities, acquisitions, and exploration activities.
